questions.question_text: Why must the name you enter in your UAC application match the name on your official identification?
options: To speed up the application processing time
To prevent issues during the university enrolment process
To ensure your ATAR is calculated correctly
To allow UAC to verify your email address
questions.explanation: Official ID must match your application name to ensure a smooth transition when you officially enrol at a university.

questions.question_text: What should you do if you have a change of name and have studied under a previous name?
options: You do not need to do anything
Contact your high school only
Provide documentary evidence like a marriage certificate or deed poll registration
Email a copy of your driver's license to the university
questions.explanation: You must supply proof of your name change so your academic records can be correctly matched to your application.

questions.question_text: Why must the name you provide in your UAC application be the same as the name on your official identification documents?
options: To ensure there are no issues during the enrolment process
To help UAC organize emails more efficiently
To prevent the application from being too long
To allow UAC to assign you a random student number
questions.explanation: UAC requires the name on the application to match your official ID to avoid problems when you eventually enrol at a university.

questions.question_text: What action should you take if you have previously studied under a different name?
options: Delete all records of your previous name
Provide evidence of your name change, such as a marriage certificate or deed poll registration
Only use your current name and ignore previous study history
Submit a new application for each name you have used
questions.explanation: If you have studied under a previous name, you must supply documentation proving the name change, such as a marriage certificate or deed poll registration.

questions.question_text: What happens if your UAC application remains inactive for 30 minutes?
options: It saves automatically and logs you out
It will stay logged in indefinitely
The system automatically logs you out
It sends a warning email to your registered address
questions.explanation: For security reasons, the UAC application system will automatically log you out if there is no activity for 30 minutes.

questions.question_text: Where should you upload documents related to a change of name?
options: In the course preferences section
At the bottom of the overview landing page under document upload
By emailing them directly to the university
In the qualifications section
questions.explanation: Documents related to a change of name should be uploaded by selecting the appropriate document type at the bottom of the application overview landing page.

questions.question_text: Why must the name you enter on your UAC application be the same as the one on your official ID?
options: To prevent issues during the university enrolment process
To qualify for lower application fees
To automatically update your bank records
To ensure you receive marketing emails
questions.explanation: UAC requires your name to match your official identification exactly to avoid problems when you officially enrol in your course.

questions.question_text: What happens if your UAC application is left without activity for 30 minutes?
options: It will automatically save and close
You will be logged out of the application
Your application will be permanently deleted
A warning email will be sent to your school
questions.explanation: To protect your information, UAC applications automatically time out and log you out after 30 minutes of inactivity.

questions.question_text: What is the recommended procedure if you have a legal change of name?
options: Contact your high school and ask them to change it
Provide documentary evidence of the change, such as a marriage or deed poll certificate
Simply update your profile name without telling UAC
Ignore it as long as your school records are current
questions.explanation: UAC requires official proof of a change of name, such as a marriage certificate or deed poll registration, to update your application records.

questions.question_text: Which contact information is critical for receiving offers from UAC?
options: Your parents' email address
Your school's general office email
A personal email address that you check regularly
Your social media profile link
questions.explanation: UAC communicates important updates and offer notifications via email, so it is vital to provide a personal address you access consistently.

questions.question_text: What is the primary requirement regarding the name provided in your application?
options: It must be your preferred nickname
It must match your official identification documents
It must be your legal name at birth only
It must contain your middle name
questions.explanation: To ensure your enrolment and records are accurate, the name provided must match your official identification documents exactly.
